name: Heard vs Thrizer
title: Heard vs Thrizer: Bookkeeping vs OON Billing for Therapists
description: Compare Heard (bookkeeping and taxes for therapists, $129/mo) vs Thrizer (free OON claims submission with reimbursement fronting). Different financial services for therapy practices.

summary.bottom_line: Heard and Thrizer solve different financial problems. Heard provides done-for-you bookkeeping and tax services ($129/mo) for therapists managing their business finances. Thrizer is a free OON claims submission platform that fronts reimbursements so clients pay copay-like amounts. Most private practice therapists could benefit from both - they're complementary, not competing.

key_differences.service_type: Heard: Bookkeeping + taxes | Thrizer: OON claims billing
key_differences.who_pays: Heard: Therapist pays | Thrizer: Client pays $1.50 + 1%
key_differences.unique_feature: Heard: Tax estimates | Thrizer: Reimbursement fronting

sections.heading: Complementary Services
sections.content: Heard and Thrizer address different aspects of running a therapy practice. Heard handles the back-office financial work: monthly bookkeeping, expense categorization, quarterly tax estimates, and optional annual tax filing. Thrizer handles client payment and insurance: automatically submitting OON claims and fronting expected reimbursements so clients pay copay-like amounts instead of full fees upfront.

sections.heading: Cost Comparison
sections.content: Heard charges therapists directly: $129/mo for Lite (bookkeeping + quarterly taxes), ~$199/mo for Essential, plus $750 for annual tax filing. Thrizer is free for therapists with a 3% payment processing fee. Thrizer's costs are paid by clients: $1.50 per claim plus 1% of the reimbursement amount. Therapists can optionally absorb Thrizer's client fees.

sections.heading: What Each Solves
sections.content: Use Heard if you hate managing finances, dread tax season, or want accurate quarterly estimates to avoid tax surprises. Use Thrizer if you're out-of-network and want to help clients use their OON benefits without the hassle of superbills - the reimbursement fronting means clients pay less upfront (post-deductible), making your practice more accessible.

sections.heading: Which Do You Need?
sections.content: Most private practice therapists benefit from both:

recommendations.when: You need bookkeeping and tax support for your practice finances.
You're out-of-network and want to help clients maximize their OON benefits without superbills.
You're a solo OON therapist wanting full financial and billing support - they serve different needs.
You're in-network only - use Headway/Alma for credentialing instead of Thrizer.

faqs.q: Can I use both Heard and Thrizer?
faqs.a: Yes, they're complementary. Heard handles your business bookkeeping and taxes. Thrizer handles client payments and OON claims. Many private practice therapists use both.
No. Heard is purely for bookkeeping and taxes - it doesn't touch insurance claims. For billing, you'd use Thrizer (OON), Headway (in-network), or another billing platform.

faqs.q: Is Thrizer only for out-of-network therapists?
faqs.a: Yes. Thrizer is specifically for OON practices. If you're in-network, you'd use Headway, Alma, or Grow Therapy for credentialing and billing instead.
After clients meet their deductible, Thrizer fronts the expected insurance reimbursement so clients pay only a copay-like amount. The therapist gets paid in full upfront.
